title: Roan of stormville NY
text: The hotels were great. Dinner and breakfast included with wine included. Tour guides and drivers were very good. I will highly recommend this tour. I took the 4 day version to fit my schedule but would. Have preferred a longer one.
author: Constancio_R

title: North Spain
text: Good tour except of the last day that was very simple. Just drived and stopped for service and lunch.
author: Anonymous

title: A Swing Through Northern Spain
text: The trip was a nice way to get a taste of sites in northern Spain. Time was very limited in most stops and will require a return trip to thoroughly explore and go more in depth.  It served our purpose of getting a glimpse of several areas we'd never been. Transportation was comfortable, lodging and meals provided were excellent.
author: Barbara_B
